name: report-pdf-fit-boundary
goal: A full-width 900px screenshot fits a single PDF evidence page without a one-pixel continuation, preserving all image pixels and tall-image pagination

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Planned feature specifies one evidence page per fitted 1440x900/1600x900 capture, complete source rows, preserved tall-image pagination, immutable original reports and visual export inspection.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unchanged pdf-screenshot-visibility suite fails only the 1440x900 fitted case: expected three image-bearing pages (cover/before/after), observed five due to 899px plus 1px crops. 1600x900 fitting and tall-image source-row preservation cases pass. Genuine latest-stage PDF continuation page inspected as blank.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Use the complete source height when the selected scale already fits the image. Retain source tiling only for genuinely tall images rendered above the fit scale; no epsilon workaround or screenshot edits.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same three screenshot visibility/source-row tests pass unchanged after the one-line fix; all seven PDF/export/JPEG preservation regressions pass. Tall-image pagination and original JPEG bytes remain covered.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full Harness bun run check passes: format/types/lint, 175 units (25 existing live opt-in skips), 49 CLI E2Es, build, packaging, root audit and 86 report tests plus report type/lint/build/audit. Isolated original-code challenge rejects [900,899,1,899,1] and the repair accepts [900,900,900], with owned temp cleanup. Regenerated real staging evidence PDFs inspected at readable resolution: 21 pages for issue 1182 and 38 for issue 986, no one-pixel image objects or blank continuation, exact original assets retained; both ZIPs below 25 MiB.
